dmisteinbergite.sense: noun: A colourless mineral, a hexagonal polymorph of anorthite,…
dmisteinbergite.hook: Wiktionary gives no earlier form for this sense.

firstUse.quote: Chesnokov et al. also reported from the same locality dmisteinbergite, a natural hexagonal polymorph of anorthite.
firstUse.source: 2001, William Alexander Deer, Robert Andrew Howie, J. Zussman, Rock-forming Minerals: Feldspars, volume 4A, page 654:
